{{Top|leg}}
The '''Rennik twins''' were the sons of [[Rennik]], a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who owned the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Worldhopper]]''.

During the journey to [[Oradin]], they strapped a conical scrap-metal cap that trailed a long ribbon of bright blue fabric on top of [[R5-G8/Legends|Gate]], [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles's]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], and then used powered-down [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] to try to shoot the ribbon. Being poor shots, they settled to shooting the droid instead.

When [[Whistler]], the astromech droid of [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], sliced into the Spaceport Security Authority and married a picture of a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who was pursuing the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] into an arrest warrant template, the Rennik twins started scattering shots into the Twi'lek's direction, giving the droids the opportunity to escape.
